evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep says 'I'm actually just calling in' and customer is Marissa; rep uses 'Marissa' once: 'I just wanted to let you know'
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'This should take about five to ten minutes of your time. Would that be okay?' — time-boxed but no explicit promise of a dependable quote, and lacks the framing about availability/dependability.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep jumps directly into logistics probing (address, square footage, rooms) with no two-concerns question.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns were raised by customer, so N/A per rubric.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection offered; no concerns were raised to reflect.
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Rep mentions 'no worry damage coverage included' ($2000 per move) and 'on time guarantee' with discounting. Missing the permission lead-in ('can I share how we work') and does not mention the On-Time Guarantee details clearly (says 'if you cannot make it' which is backwards — it's if WE are late). Damage coverage is clear but On-Time details are muddled.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No close-the-loop question like 'Does that put those to rest?' was asked.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening_and_logistics: Rep opens with 'So just to make sure the first location is...' (checklist-based, not concern-led). However, logistics are fully covered: both addresses, square footage, floor/stories, walking distances, additional rooms, special items (65-inch TV), and access concerns all gathered.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Both asked: 'do we have anything larger heavy' and 'A typical back count based on your home says is fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep gives pricing contrast (hourly rate vs. all-inclusive: 'we charge an hourly rate of 104 dollars per hour per mover... everything is already included'), mentions 'no hidden fees of any type,' and states 'no need to take notes' implicitly ('I'll send you the confirmation email'). Missing explicit 'Save Your Ass' prep framing tied to the estimate. Score: two of three.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives anchored range ('typical one bedroom apartment would normally take two movers that's between two and a half to three and a half hours') and personalizes it ('in your case... This is a two story town home. So, we'll send out 3 movers... estimated time is between three to four hours estimated cost... In case they end the four hours would be $832'). Full.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep offers one date option ('October 20th Tuesday... 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM') with no mention of Value Days, cheaper alternative days, or flexibility discussion. Not addressed.
evidence_quotes.prep_and_temperature_check: Rep gives prep framing: 'the most important one is how well prepared you are when we get there... we are efficient when we are moving big boxes, big furniture but we... lose some efficiency when we get down to small miscellaneous items.' Then asks 'Does that make sense?' (not the exact 'How do you feel about that?' but functionally equivalent). However, rep does not hold silence — immediately continues without a genuine pause. Partial.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'do you still have any other questions before I let you go?' — this is a throwaway 'any questions' variant, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No catch-all ('Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?') was asked.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep says 'There's no deposit required, no re securing your spot' then 'Would you like me to lock that in for you?' — rate lock (implicit, no cancellation fees) and no deposit stated before the ask. The ask is plain and direct. Full.

top_strength: Zhang gathered comprehensive logistics details (both addresses, square footage, floor/stories, walking distances, access concerns, special items, and box count) efficiently and accurately, setting up a solid estimate.
coaching_note: Step 2 is completely missing — start every sales call with the two-concerns question (movers not showing on time vs. damage to items) *before* any probing begins, then follow up two layers deep to uncover what truly matters to this customer.
